content: Symbolic baseRef and exact checkpoint commit roles are distinct and consistently documented.
Latest reachable package checkpoint and current content checks are fail-closed.
Stale, unreachable, unresolved, missing-package, and drifted paths are mutation-free refusals.
Repository, branch, worktree path, identity, and readiness checks remain unchanged.
Diff stays within Work Unit scope.

content.summary: symbolic baseRef는 package history owner로, requested base는 exact execution commit으로 분리됐다. latest reachable package checkpoint 및 current content 비교가 stale, unrelated, missing-package, unresolved, drifted 입력을 fail-closed로 거절하고 기존 mutation boundary를 보존한다.
completedChecks: exact checkpoint는 unrelated main advance 후에도 admission된다.
advanced main 직접 입력은 branch/worktree mutation 전에 거절된다.
stale, unreachable, package 생성 전, drifted base 회귀가 manager 테스트로 검증된다.
repository, branch, canonical path, identity, ready 검증은 기존 전체 회귀에서 통과한다.
변경은 Work Unit이 지정한 7개 구현·테스트·계약 파일로 제한됐다.
